faq.question: What is in this blend?
faq.answer: CJC-1295 without DAC and Ipamorelin at matched ratios: 5+5 mg (code CP10) and 10+10 mg (CP20) per vial, 10 vials per kit.

faq.question: Why is the no-DAC CJC-1295 used rather than the DAC version?
faq.answer: Because the no-DAC analogue has a shorter half-life in research models, which suits protocols designed around a tighter stimulation window; CJC-1295 with DAC is supplied separately as code CD5.

faq.question: How does this compare with the GHRP-2 / GHRP-6 blends?
faq.answer: This kit pairs a GHRH-receptor agonist with a selective ghrelin-receptor agonist. GHRP-2 and GHRP-6 are ghrelin-receptor agonists with different receptor-affinity and appetite-related research profiles, and are supplied as individual products.

faq.question: What documentation is supplied?
faq.answer: Component-level analytical documentation (HPLC purity, MS identity) for both peptides, plus invoice and packing list.
